  Watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ

  Watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ

  Watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ watan meiṅ aa gai huṅ

  7

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/watan-mein-aa-gai.md\")
original = path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\")
metadata, separator, lyric = original.partition(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")
roman, boundary, source = lyric.partition(\"\\n---\\n\")
assert separator and boundary
updated = re.sub(r\"\\b[Mm](?:ai|ei)ṅ\\b\", lambda match: match[0][:-1] + \"n\", roman)
updated = re.sub(r\"\\bnana\\b\", \"naana\", updated).replace(\"Haae naana\", \"Haaye naana\")
roman_blocks = updated.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
source_blocks = source.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 11
for index, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.strip().splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines)
    if index >= 2:
        assert roman_lines[0] == str(index - 1)
        assert source_lines[0] == str(index - 1).translate(str.maketrans(\"123456789\", \"۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\"))
assert all(ord(char) < 128 or char in \"ṅṄ\" for char in updated)
path.write_bytes((metadata + separator + updated + boundary + source).encode(\"utf-8\"))
assert path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\").partition(\"\\n---\\n\")[2] == source
PY
git diff -- src/data/lyrics/watan-mein-aa-gai.md"

item.text: Audited the Roman transliteration verse by verse against the Urdu, including the opening and all nine numbered stanzas. Corrected `main` and `mein` to distinguish “I” from “in,” and normalized `Haaye` and `naana`. The Urdu body and all other metadata were preserved. No unresolved discrepancies surfaced.
